task_summary: Reviewed FacultyWidget as a compatibility re-export with no independent UI; migrated ProposalRehearsalModal chrome to shared Radix Dialog, semantic tokens, Buttons, and Badges while preserving the official 16:9 slide canvas and rehearsal behavior. Focused suites pass 16/16, scoped lint/format pass, the 4,853-module production build passes, and 16 Playwright captures cover light/dark desktop/mobile review/edit states. Inventory: 137/278 source-updated, 3 reviewed-no-ui, 138 pending; full refactor remains active.
key_decisions: Used the existing plan direction of restrained shadcn surfaces with BukSU identity and both themes; kept official 16:9 canvas artwork, logos, and institutional footer intact.
Moved the fullscreen shell to the shared Radix Dialog portal and delegated focus, Escape dismissal, overlay, and scroll locking to that primitive.
Kept Escape in edit mode focused: a first Escape blurs an active contentEditable field, a second Escape exits edit mode, and a regular Escape closes the dialog.
Used shared Buttons for all slide controls and semantic tokens for the theater shell; added portalContainer support to shared DialogContent without changing its default portal behavior.
Classified FacultyWidget as reviewed-no-ui because it only re-exports the already migrated FacultyCommitteeCard.
lessons_learned: Radix scroll locking is represented by data-scroll-locked and injected stylesheet rules rather than an inline body style in JSDOM.
Global presentation shortcuts should not intercept keyboard input while a button or slider has focus; let native controls retain Enter/Space behavior.
open_threads: Continue the 138 pending source modules and complete the plan-wide route/state and final quality gates.
verification_notes: ProposalRehearsalModal.test.jsx passes 9/9; ProjectDetailsModal.test.jsx passes 7/7 after the shared Dialog portal option was added. Scoped ESLint and Prettier pass. Production client build passes with 4,853 modules transformed; existing Tailwind ease ambiguity and large-chunk warnings remain. Sixteen Playwright captures cover review/edit in light/dark at 1440x900 and 390x844 with no viewport escape, overflow, theme mismatch, browser errors, or broken interactions. Workspace evidence validation is pending after the final PTSS update.
